summary: Switch Ghost Ship runtime map delivery from the browser-rejected WebP to the release-generated JPEG and verify real Chromium decoding before and after Forge upload.

operations.before: const file = new File([blob], MAP_FILENAME, { type: blob.type || "image/webp" });
operations.after: const file = new File([blob], MAP_FILENAME, { type: "image/jpeg" });

checks.name: JPEG path and browser decode checks
checks.run: grep -q 'signatory-ghost-ship.jpg' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q 'createImageBitmap' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && ! grep -q 'MAP_REMOTE_FALLBACK' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs
